# Derivation-path conformance table, shared verbatim by go-mhda
# (testdata/dp_conformance.txt) and the C++ port (tests/data/dp_conformance.txt).
# Both test suites run every row; a path one implementation refuses, the other
# refuses too. Edit both copies together.
#
# Row forms:
#   accept <dt> <dp> <canonical dp>
#   refuse <dt> <dp>
# A refused row fails with ErrInvalidDerivationPath / error_code::invalid_derivation_path.
#
# Each level's index is 0..2^31-1; the hardened marker is a separate flag.
# 2147483647 is the largest index, 2147483648 (2^31) and 4294967295 (2^32-1)
# are refused at every level of every type, hardened or not. Values at a
# level whose shape they do not fit (an unhardened account, a hardened
# charge, any value in a fixed level) are refused for shape.

# bip32 m/0'/0/0
# bip32 account (hardened only)
refuse bip32 m/2147483647/0/0
accept bip32 m/2147483647'/0/0 m/2147483647'/0/0
refuse bip32 m/2147483648/0/0
refuse bip32 m/2147483648'/0/0
refuse bip32 m/4294967295/0/0
refuse bip32 m/4294967295'/0/0
# bip32 charge (fixed 0|1)
refuse bip32 m/0'/2147483647/0
refuse bip32 m/0'/2147483647'/0
refuse bip32 m/0'/2147483648/0
refuse bip32 m/0'/2147483648'/0
refuse bip32 m/0'/4294967295/0
refuse bip32 m/0'/4294967295'/0
# bip32 index (hardening optional)
accept bip32 m/0'/0/2147483647 m/0'/0/2147483647
accept bip32 m/0'/0/2147483647' m/0'/0/2147483647'
refuse bip32 m/0'/0/2147483648
refuse bip32 m/0'/0/2147483648'
refuse bip32 m/0'/0/4294967295
refuse bip32 m/0'/0/4294967295'

# Hardened markers h and H count like ' and are emitted as '.
accept bip44 m/44h/60H/2147483647h/0/2147483647H m/44'/60'/2147483647'/0/2147483647'
refuse bip44 m/44'/60'/2147483648h/0/0

# Beyond 32 bits.
refuse bip44 m/44'/60'/0'/0/4294967296
refuse bip44 m/44'/60'/0'/0/18446744073709551616
refuse slip10 m/99999999999999999999
refuse slip10 m/0/99999999999999999999'

# Leading zeros. A variable level accepts them and the canonical form drops
# them; the range check applies to the value. A fixed level (purpose, the
# fixed coin of cip11/cip1852/zip32, the 0|1 charge of bip32 and the
# BIP-44 family) must be spelled exactly as in its template.
accept bip44 m/44'/060'/0'/0/0 m/44'/60'/0'/0/0
accept bip44 m/44'/60'/00'/0/00 m/44'/60'/0'/0/0
accept bip44 m/44'/60'/0'/0/02147483647 m/44'/60'/0'/0/2147483647
accept bip44 m/44'/60'/0'/0/000000000000000000002147483647' m/44'/60'/0'/0/2147483647'
refuse bip44 m/44'/60'/0'/0/02147483648
refuse bip44 m/44'/60'/000000000000000000002147483648'/0/0
refuse bip44 m/044'/60'/0'/0/0
refuse bip44 m/44'/60'/0'/00/0
refuse bip44 m/44'/60'/0'/01/0
refuse bip84 m/084'/0'/0'/0/0
refuse bip32 m/0'/00/0
accept bip32 m/00'/1/007' m/0'/1/7'
refuse cip11 m/044'/118'/0'/0/0
refuse cip11 m/44'/0118'/0'/0/0
accept cip11 m/44'/118'/0'/09/0 m/44'/118'/0'/9/0
